priceScale: Raw daily prices determine historical eligibility. Split-affected sessions require raw fifteen-minute decision bars. Split-adjusted daily technical history is scaled into session nominal units using a validated opening-derived split factor. Minute execution bars are raw, preserving actual whole-share affordability.
dataQualityPolicy: Exclude and disclose stock-sessions whose raw and adjusted series do not provide a consistent opening-derived corporate-action scale. Never repair them using future trade returns or assume a fill. Such exclusions remain subject to the historical-universe/data audit before promotion.

scanner.rank: opening relative volume times (1 + absolute opening gap fraction), then symbol

signalRules.decisionBars: completed 15-minute regular-session bars; first post-range decision at 10:00 Eastern; latest decision at 11:00 Eastern
signalRules.marketRegime: previous SPY close above prior 50-close average and current SPY close above its cumulative regular-session HLC-volume VWAP
signalRules.breakout: opening candle bullish; current close crosses opening high, exceeds VWAP, outperforms SPY since open, is no more than 0.25 ATR above opening high and 0.75 ATR above VWAP; opening gap between 0% and 5%
signalRules.reclaim: opening candle bearish with low at least 0.25 prior-session ATR below prior close; completed later close crosses above VWAP, closes above previous bar high and current open, and exceeds session open; absolute opening gap at most 5%
signalRules.stop: minimum low of the signal and preceding 15-minute bars, rounded down to cents
signalRules.attempts: first valid opportunity per stock/setup/session only; unfilled orders are not chased

selection: Compare six predefined setup/universe combinations on development data only. Freeze the highest risk-adjusted eligible combination before later periods. If none qualifies, retain the highest scoring diagnostic only. Do not activate from these results.
limitations: Current listing and current S&P 500 snapshots are not point-in-time historical membership; results are survivorship-biased diagnostics.
Previous experiments exposed these dates. Chronological separation is retrospective and cannot be claimed as a pristine holdout.
Without historical AAOIFI and time-stamped catalysts, these runs evaluate price/volume selection proxies only.
Fifteen-minute completed bars generate decisions; one-minute bars are required for every potential trading session to simulate execution.
Nominal session scaling is reconstructed from raw and split-adjusted opening prices and requires matching-series validation; it is not a full corporate-action or historical-symbol audit.
Historical SIP access does not establish real-time SIP permission.
